registry_disposition.reason: S7 runtime instruction digest derivation, executed under the scoped residual closure run directive of 2026-10-21 (S7/S8 residual obligations). It closes the OPEN obligation recorded by the predecessor S7 run (evidence/qualification-integration-2026-10-20/RUN.md): the effective instruction digest is now DERIVED at run time from the effective instruction bundle the run actually gets, instead of being spec-declared data. The new runtime module runtime/qualification/instruction-binding.mjs assembles the bundle with the S6 assembler over the live instruction tree (runtime/context/instruction-bundle-assembler.mjs), recomputes the digest from the bundle's own content and order, re-reads every selected source against the tree, and binds the DERIVED digest into every current qualification fingerprint (the fingerprint digest is recomputed with it). A caller-asserted digest is recorded in the new instruction-binding.json run artifact for traceability and never used for a decision, so it can no longer legitimize a qualification. runtime/cli/runtime-run.mjs wires the derivation in: the run spec carries instruction_binding (the assembly inputs), the CLI derives the binding and passes the BOUND fingerprints to the eligibility gate, and the qualified snapshots keep the digest they were earned under, so a material instruction change is a MATERIAL_FINGERPRINT_DRIFT and the run is blocked until the qualification is re-earned. The source snapshot label is content-addressed (content:<sha256>), so a caller cannot name a revision and pin a stale state. The coordinated data amendments are the reference run spec runtime/cli/specs/reference-audit-v1.json (re-earned binding), the six committed model-adaptive profiles and their contract fixture and test constant (re-earned: docs/authority-matrix.md is a canonical instruction source, and registering the new surface family in it moved the effective instruction state, which the S7 semantics correctly invalidated), the vNext maturity baseline evals/fixtures/maws-vnext-baseline.json and the authority matrix row in docs/authority-matrix.md. The new tool scripts/tools/requalify-run-spec.mjs re-binds the qualification snapshots of a run spec to the instruction state in effect; it is a calculator, it grants no capability, qualifies no executor and changes no permission. The new test file tests/vnext/instruction-binding.test.mjs carries 16 tests, including the repository gate that fails when the instruction state moved without a re-qualification. SCOPE, explicitly not claimed: the specification stays PROPOSED, this run qualifies no model and no executor, grants no permission, activates no runtime and replaces no authority or approval decision; the derived digest binds the canonical instruction sources of the effective bundle plus whatever the assembly policy selects, and a source that is neither canonical nor selected is not part of the effective instruction bundle (that is the S6 assembly rule). The canonical owner authority publishes no key and no skill was promoted on a live canonical tree (the S8 side of this run). The independent review was performed by a local audit agent (the codex review connector was quota-exhausted) over three rounds with mutation probes; every finding was real and every claimed gate is now bound by at least one failing test; no human approval is claimed. The hosted GitHub Actions job could not execute (the account is locked for a billing issue); every CI step was replicated locally on the published head and the absence of a hosted run is disclosed rather than presented as a green gate. The Registry write is required and pending: the run change registration registry/MAWS_INSTRUCTION_DIGEST_DERIVATION_2026_10_21_001.yaml and the CONTRACT_RECORD projection registry/MAWS_INSTRUCTION_DIGEST_DERIVATION_CONTRACT_2026_10_21_001.yaml are published after the source merge, and the Atlas representation follows the Registry. The owner-side classification is rebound from REQUIRED_BUT_BLOCKED to UPDATED with the registry commit sha after that publication; the recorded facts of the source change are unchanged.
